_question: A queue row reported the loop witness RED on unmodified master: zero layer flips at all three derived speeds and the player falling, including at $600 — the speed our own doc records as the negative control, where the crossover fix must be a no-op. Is that an engine defect, or a witness whose setup coordinates no longer match the content?
_verdict: OUTCOME (b) WITH A REAL DEFECT ATTACHED, and the two halves must not be collapsed. The RED REPRODUCES EXACTLY on unmodified master — so the sighting was truthfully reported, not imagined. But it is NOT an engine defect: the witness places the player at a hardcoded world Y that the level content moved out from under, 12 px inside a floor cell that did not exist when the coordinate was chosen. Corrected for that one number and nothing else, all three speeds are GREEN. The defect that was real is in the INSTRUMENT — it reported a setup failure in the exact shape of the engine failure it exists to detect — and that is what this parcel fixes.

SEVEN collision commits landed between that table and HEAD (13ef3cf4, 902be5c7, 26750443, 97d7851a, 78ac6882, c9a6fe8b, 962400e8), including the arc foot that caused this whole investigation. The loop is not the same loop. This run is therefore evidence that the crossover FIRES AT ALL THREE SPEEDS AND NOBODY FALLS THROUGH — it is NOT a reproduction of that table's figures and must not be quoted as one.

what: --start-y: the placement Y is now an argument, because it is a coordinate into content that moves.

A PLACEMENT PRECONDITION, asserted rather than assumed: after the landing frames, y_vel must be 0. If it is not, the tool REFUSES with the placed coordinate, the measured y, the measured y_vel and the editor column to check — instead of driving on and reporting a loop result.
--no-assert-grounded to run anyway, for the case where the ungrounded drive is itself the subject.
A note beside START_Y recording that this coordinate has already gone stale once, naming 78ac6882 and the y576 -> y560 move, so the next reader does not re-derive it.
the_fix.why_the_assertion_and_not_just_the_numbe: Fixing 553 to 537 fixes today and leaves the trap armed. The failure mode is that a SETUP failure and the ENGINE failure this witness detects have the same signature — zero flips, a long drop — so the instrument cannot be trusted to tell them apart by eye. The assertion is what makes them distinguishable, and it is loud rather than green-on-unmeasurable.
